# Security reporting

Report suspected vulnerabilities or exposed sensitive data through
[GitHub private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/cptntrps/korean-word-of-the-day/security/advisories/new).
Reports go to the repository's maintainers.

Include the affected URL or file, a short description, and enough redacted detail
to locate the issue. Do not include active credentials, private personal data, or
other people's confidential material in your report.

Do not open a public issue or pull request containing sensitive details.
For non-sensitive bugs and suggestions, see [Contributing](CONTRIBUTING.md).
